The task: "All of the individuals who formally held the position of United States secretary of homeland security prior to April 2019, excluding those who held the position in an acting capacity, have a bachelor's degree. Of the universities that these bachelor's degrees were from, which is the westernmost university and which is the easternmost university? Give them to me as a comma-separated list, I only want the name of the cities where the universities are located, with the westernmost city listed first."

We need to verify the list of secretaries prior to April 2019, excluding acting. The secretaries: Tom Ridge (2003-2005), Michael Chertoff (2005-2009), Janet Napolitano (2009-2013), Jeh Charles Johnson (2013-2017), John F. Kelly (2017-2017? Actually Kelly served Jan 20, 2017 – July 28, 2017), Kirstjen M. Nielsen (Dec 6, 2017 – April 10, 2019). Also there was an acting secretary: James Loy (acting after Ridge? Actually James Loy served as acting deputy? Not sure). Also Rand Beers served as acting after Napolitano? Actually after Napolitano, there was an acting secretary Rand Beers? Let's check: According to DHS history, after Janet Napolitano left in Sep 2013, there was an acting secretary Rand Beers? Actually Jeh Johnson was confirmed Dec 2013. There might have been an acting secretary between Napolitano and Johnson: Rand Beers served as acting secretary from Sep 6
